user_decision: General CSV/Excel with explicit column mapping; improve currency add/remove controls while preserving financial history.
features: Kelola mata uang adds/hides catalog codes with at least one visible currency; unused changes cancel without a write and hidden used currencies retain report access.

Wallet creation, transaction input, history/reporting and major-unit FX support currency-specific0/2/3/4minor digits. Existing IDR/TRY/USD storage and valid legacy FX boundary amounts remain unchanged.

CSV / Excel umum maps date, description, signed amount or debit/credit, running balance and optional reference/currency, worksheet and header row. Existing Ziraat TRY automatic reader and fingerprints are retained.
Strict checks reject currency mismatch, unsafe precision, invalid dates/order, zero or conflicting direction, broken balance chains, formula cells and overflow before financial writing.
Preview changes/file replacement/target archive invalidate stale save decisions. Existing source/manual overlap, capacity, Web Locks/CAS and failed-save recovery paths are reused.
Backup/restore preserves visible currency settings, extended codes, archives and generic source facts in the gated v6 codec. Old feature-free wire serialization remains compatible.
New28-case production browser gate is wired into the existing local CI workflow with evidence upload; external CI has not been executed.
how_to_use: Open Kelola mata uang, choose a currency, click Tambah mata uang, then Simpan mata uang. Sembunyikan changes choices only; Buka laporan opens hidden used history.
Create an active bank wallet in that currency, then open Impor mutasi > CSV / Excel umum and choose the target wallet.
Choose CSV/TSV/XLSX, map required columns including genuine running balance, set decimal/date/order, confirm the file currency, then create the preview.
Review duplicate candidates, categories and projected balance before the explicit save. Nothing is financially saved during mapping alone.

retained_initial_failures.reason: Initial independent synthetic v6 fixture encoding was noncanonical and the app correctly refused it without a write. Fixture encoder corrected; initial diagnostics retained.

limits: Generic import supports UTF-8 CSV/TSV and unencrypted XLSX with one account/currency and a genuine running-balance column. Legacy XLS/ODS/PDF and files without running balance are not supported by this path.
Column mapping, decimal convention, date format, source order and target currency require explicit confirmation. Import does not convert currency or infer account ownership.
Catalog ships 165 codes with defined numeric minor units from the SIX ISO4217 snapshot published2026-09-17; it is not an online exchange-rate feed or arbitrary custom-token registry.
Currency removal means hiding an available choice. Used wallets, balances and history remain accessible; no financial data is deleted or converted by this setting.

New multicurrency/visibility/generic-source data use table-tuples-v6. Older applications reject the unsupported format rather than silently discarding features; legacy v1/older supported formats remain readable.

Raw import file8MiB, expanded XLSX32MiB,50000transactions and512columns are bounded independently from the logical stored-wire8MiB and browser quota. Oversize or failed writes preserve existing durable data.
Cross-format candidate duplicates require an explicit keep/distinct decision; incomplete legacy evidence cannot prove identity and is not silently linked.
Browser tests used fresh synthetic Chromium Windows contexts and320px mobile emulation. Physical Safari/iOS/Android, manual screen readers and every possible bank workbook were not tested.
Contrast measurements cover sampled visible solid text/controls; gradients and disabled controls are excluded.
Performance gate covers10individually saved edits on a10k plain ledger; it does not guarantee65k or metadata-heavy UI performance.
Legacy missing source facts, dates and associations remain unresolved without original evidence. Full historical cloud A-H source is not claimed recovered.
No personal backup/profile was read or migrated in this feature task. No online change, external CI execution, push, deployment, ZIP bundle or off-PC backup was performed.
